parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language in which you want the values of some response parameters to be returned. These response parameters support multiple languages. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 200.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **DOMAIN**: domain name

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-tags --lang en --resource-type DOMAIN --page-number 1 --page-size 200 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeTags --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 200 --PageNumber 1 --Lang en --ResourceType DOMAIN
